facts.fact: The Zama 2026 diaspora round-table report presents a national AI policy for Madagascar as something still to be built, under a heading on a national AI policy and sovereignty 'to be built', and proposes local citizen conventions to draft one; it names no existing or draft strategy (report dated 2026-07, no event day given, so the published date is used).

note: Only the standing aspect has a fact; the report names no body or funding for an AI strategy.
